task: VAL-SAFE-05 / reviewer B1: snapshot exclusion-refresh must fail closed
summary: B1 fail closed. _snapshot_excluded_passthrough_names() swallowed refresh exceptions and returned the possibly-unfiltered cached set (fail-open), so a broken refresh let profile-scoped passthrough names (BUZZ_*, configured passthrough) persist unfiltered into the shared env snapshot that later commands source. Fix in tools/environments/base.py only: (1) monotonic latch _snapshot_exclusion_broken set on any get_all_passthrough/import failure, never cleared; (2) previous exclusion set retained on failure; (3) init_session bootstrap aborts with exit 1 before any dump when latched (no snapshot file written, previous good snapshot untouched, commands fall back to per-command login shells); (4) _wrap_command skips the per-command re-dump when latched (old snapshot never replaced by unfiltered content); (5) belt unset of BUZZ_* (and existing HERMES_SESSION_* etc.) inside the dump script so known first-party secret prefixes are excluded even with an empty exclusion set. Strict failing-test-first: tests written first, 8 failed for the right reason (dump showed declare -x BUZZ_TEST_TOKEN persisted after injected failure; seeded snapshot overwritten), then patch turned them green.
left_undone: 3 pre-existing environmental neighbor failures, verified identical on pristine base.py (PRISTINE_EXIT=1): test_docker_environment.py::test_wrapped_exec_scopes_explicit_forward_env_across_profiles and ::test_persistent_bind_mounts_survive_a_session_key_task_id (Windows-path docker bind mounts), test_agent_env_advertisement.py::TestWrapCommandAdvertisesHarness::test_shell_sets_default_and_preserves_outer (bash resolves to WSL stub). Not in scope, no unrelated hardening performed.
